name: Startup Capital 2
description:
The rumors are true – we listened and are happy to announce that 
 🚀Startup Capital 🚀 is BACK!!

TechBBQ will host, the second edition of our online matchmaking event – 💥 Startup Capital 2. This event connects pre-seed, seed-stage, and series-A startups with international investors through virtually facilitated matchmaking activities. The event is going to happen virtually on the 7th of October 2020.

Startup Capital will link together 50 Global VC Fund and 50 Nordic and Baltic startups in a 4-hour session! 🔥

Our goal is to facilitate and curate efficient 💬conversations between startups and investors to increase investment flow, enhance Impact, align capital, reduce perceived investment risks and encourage continuous collaboration between investors and entrepreneurs – for the purpose of exchanging 💸financing and 📚knowledge flows.

This project is done in partnership with byFounders, Silicon Valley Bank, Danish Business Angels, Innovation Fund Denmark, Innovation centre Denmark, Danske Bank, and Vækstfonden.

✏️The application deadline is on 10th September 2020. 

If you are a startup register here 👉: https://fal.cn/techbbq0741
If you are an investor register here 👉: https://fal.cn/techbbq0742
